values.description: Simulates an intermittently failing downstream service

properties.name: chaos.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for HavocFlow chaos injection. Must be true for any chaos to be applied. NEVER set to true in production.

properties.name: chaos.dry-run
properties.description: When true, the chaos engine logs what it would do but does not actually inject latency or exceptions.

properties.name: chaos.default-failure-rate
properties.description: Default failure probability (0.0–1.0) applied when @InjectChaos does not specify failureRate.

properties.name: chaos.scenarios
properties.description: Named chaos scenarios. Reference them with @InjectChaos(scenario = "name").
